Name: Some Vegetable Dehydrator Products
Author: HellaGayJaime
Description:
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I made this mod to do a few things:[/color][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Allow some vegetables to go into the dehydrator with believable unique products (dried broccoli sounds weird and gross)[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]For those products to have clues to who they should be given to, like the Pirate Locket quest[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]To expand loved gifts for a few hard-to-gift villagers (some easy gifters got new options too)[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Most of the products follow the same price formula as dried fruit. Some get a little boost. Requires 5 as usual.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Kale → Kale Chips[/color]
Potato → Mashed Potato Mix
Corn → Microwave Popcorn
Beet → Red Coloring
Garlic → Garlic Powder
Tomato → Tomato Paste
Hops → Bittering Agent
Wheat → Breakfast Cereal
Amaranth → Amaranth Cereal

[b]Version 1.1 has arrived! Now you can cook all the items except Kale Chips.[/b]

Microwave Popcorn and Mashed Potato Mix can be cooked with just the item. Unlocked by default. Basic food.
Red coloring + other ingredients can be used to make [b]Ferngill Fish[/b], a candy that gives +5 Luck. Unlocked at Level 10 Fishing.
Garlic Powder, Tomato Paste + Many other ingredients can be used to make [b]Chili[/b], an epic food that rivals Magic Rock Candy. Unlocked at level 10 combat.
Amaranth Cereal + Many other ingredients can be used to make [b]Deluxe Field Snack[/b], an upgraded version of our old friend, the Field Snack. It buffs luck, foraging, and max energy. Recipe unlocks at level 5 Foraging.
Bittering agent + Other ingredients can be used to make [b]Digestive Bitters[/b], which buffs max energy. It is also unlocked at Foraging 5.
Have you ever wished there was an early-game access to max energy buffing? So you can get the most out of those Year 1 days? Now you can make a [b]Giant Bowl of Cereal[/b] with Breakfast Cereal and any milk. Unlocked by default.
What's that? You want to make a bowl of Amaranth Cereal? Too bad. Your character thinks it gets soggy too fast and prefers to eat it straight from the box. :)

See spoiler for loved gift hints.
[spoiler]Movie concession tastes were somewhat taken into account.
Some villagers get more than one new loved gift. Some get none.
Some things that villagers wouldn't normally like might be different. In fact, I made a few characters step out of their comfort zone.
Amaranth Cereal is good for those with digestive issues. I took some creative liberty with who this applies to. The key is in what they hate.
The intended recipient for Digestive Bitters is not the same as Amaranth Cereal.[/spoiler]

See spoiler for plainly written loved gift matchups.
[spoiler]Sam, Caroline, and Alex love Kale Chips
Jodi and Kent love Mashed Potato Mix
Demetrius and Sandy love Microwave Popcorn. I'm really proud of the dialogue I wrote for when you give it to Demetrius.
Leah, Robin, and Emily love Red Coloring
Gus loves Tomato Paste and Garlic Powder
Harvey loves Bittering Agent
Jas and Vincent love Breakfast Cereal
Pierre loves Amaranth Cereal
Pam loves Ferngill Fish
Linus loves Deluxe Field Snack
Willy loves Chili
Leo loves Giant Bowl of Cereal
Kent loves Popcorn
Wizard loves Mashed Potatoes
George loves Digestive Bitters. Also really proud of this dialogue.
[/spoiler]
Feel free to translate my mod, report bugs, and give suggestions!

[color=#ff0000][b]If red coloring is broken in your version, please download the new version! I also fixed the update key (yikes)[/b] [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unzip in your \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods folder.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Do the same for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] if you haven't already. You need these for most Stardew mods.[/color]

[color=#666666][i]Trivia[/i][/color]
[color=#666666][i]Some of the sprites are inspired by real-world brands: Idahoan Mashed Potatoes, Napoleon Tomato Paste, Life multigrain cereal, and Swedish Fish[/i][/color]
